days.title: Shoreline Villages and Beaches
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Walchensee
stops.detail: Walchensee (lake) is also called the "Bavarian Caribbean", because of its turquoise-green water.

stops.name: Urfeld
stops.detail: One of the most tranquil places on the lake is the traffic-free eastern shore between Urfeld and Niedernach.

stops.name: Zwergern
stops.detail: The Zwergern Walchensee peninsula offers another great swimming opportunity – and a magnificent view of the mountains and villages.

stops.name: Jochberg
stops.detail: The mountains around Walchensee are among Munich's most popular landmarks– such as the Jochberg (1,565 m).

stops.name: Jocheralm
stops.detail: From the top, you have a magnificent view of Kochelsee and Walchensee (lakes), and you can stop for a snack at Jocheralm.

stops.name: Herzogstand
stops.detail: Maybe the Herzogstand (mountain) (1,731 m) is an even more popular destination – especially because of the Herzogstand cable car.

stops.name: Herzogstand mountain inn
stops.detail: But you can also just sit on the terrace of the Herzogstand mountain inn and enjoy the picturesque view of the surrounding lakes and the Karwendel mountains.
